model: Typical 23 C cell curves, quasi-static constant power, explicit interconnect drop/loss; no cell-resistance double counting

settings.status: validation candidate; not substituted into retained experiments

basis.capacity_scale: Murata minimum/nominal capacity ratio 3000/3120; horizontal capacity sensitivity, not a guarantee on the shape of a minimum cell curve
basis.interconnect_resistance_ohm: Unmeasured assembly requirement; vary 0..0.03 ohm. Excludes cell resistance already represented by loaded cell curves.
basis.curve_voltage_shift_v: Digitisation/curve sensitivity; not a statistical confidence bound
basis.temperature_c: Manufacturer curve test temperature only; other temperatures not validated
basis.reaction_torque_ratio_m: Reference-model assumption; yaw authority needs a measured propeller torque/RPM map
basis.mechanical_principal_plane_offset_mm: Geometric placement allocation inside the lens; calibration required. Camera/lens external dimensions are manufacturer specifications.

profile_order: Existing engineering phase list; recovery and admission blocks follow motion blocks. Tail at maximum phase-average adverse load. Additional chronological placement is a separate sensitivity.
